met_analysis:
The low pressure area over southeast Jharkhand & neighbourhood has become less marked, however the associated cyclonic circulation extending upto 4.5 km above mean sea level persisted over the same region.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes through Firozpur, Rohtak, Orai, Sidhi, Ranchi, Digha& thence southeastwards to Eastcentral Bay of Bengal.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over northwest Bay of Bengal between 5.8 & 7.6 km above mean sea levels persists. Under its influence, a low Pressure area likely to form over north Bay of Bengal during next 48 hours.
The Shear Zone roughly along Lat. 22°N across central & adjoining north Peninsular India between 5.8 & 7.6 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over southwest Rajasthan & neighbourhoodat 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation lies over central Assam extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
